lib/account.ts#requestSignInLink: public: a shopper asks for a sign-in link by e-mail (rate-limited in the browser today; server must rate-limit)
lib/account.ts#verifySignInLink: public: the link's one-time token is the credential
lib/account.ts#verifyOnce: public: the six-digit code is the credential
lib/account.ts#saveProfile: self: the signed-in shopper's own profile (server must take the shopper from the session, never from the request)
lib/account.ts#deleteAccount: self: the signed-in shopper closes their own account
lib/account.ts#finishLeaving: self: the signed-in shopper confirms closing their own account
lib/newsletter.ts#subscribe: public: anyone signs up; double opt-in follows
lib/newsletter.ts#confirmSubscription: public: the e-mailed token is the credential
lib/newsletter.ts#updatePreferences: public: the e-mailed token is the credential
lib/newsletter.ts#unsubscribe: public: the e-mailed token is the credential (one click, no sign-in, by law)
lib/newsletter.ts#sendDue: system: sends scheduled newsletters when their time comes (becomes a server cron job)
lib/staff-updates.ts#sendDueStaffUpdates: system: sends scheduled staff updates when their time comes (becomes a server cron job)
lib/ops/feedback.ts#submitFeedback: public: the Feedback button on every page (server must rate-limit and filter spam)
lib/ops/requests.ts#submitRequest: public: the community request form (server must rate-limit and filter spam)
lib/store.ts#addApplicant: public: anyone applies for a job (server must rate-limit; uploads go to private storage)
lib/promo.ts#claimCode: self: the signed-in shopper claims a code for themselves (limits are checked in the write)
lib/hr/hr.ts#openOutcome: self: the signed-in applicant opens the update on their own application
lib/hr/hr.ts#acceptOffer: self: the signed-in applicant accepts their own offer
lib/hr/hr.ts#declineOffer: self: the signed-in applicant declines their own offer
lib/staff-updates.ts#markStaffUpdateRead: self: the signed-in employee marks an update read
lib/store.ts#requestLeave: self: the signed-in employee asks for leave for themselves
lib/store.ts#requestSwap: self: the signed-in employee asks to swap their own shift
lib/store.ts#setTrainingDone: self: the signed-in employee completes their own training
lib/store.ts#updateEmployee: self: the signed-in employee edits their own profile (Profile page)
